headline: Sony adds lottery system for PS5 Pro purchases in Japan
summary: Facing device shortages and scalpers, Sony introduced a lottery system to buy PS5 Pro consoles in Japan, requiring proof of actual console use, including a 60-hour playtime requirement, to qualify.

claims.statement: Sony introduced a lottery system to purchase PS5 Pro consoles in Japan amid shortages.
